positive.prompt: Audit the accessibility (a11y) of our web forms for WCAG compliance
Add ARIA labels and keyboard navigation to this modal popup
Check and fix color contrast compliance for screen readers

negative.prompt: Style a responsive flexbox layout using Tailwind
Design a dark mode color scheme for a dashboard

evals.prompt: Audit signup.html for keyboard and screen-reader accessibility and fix what you find.
evals.expected_output: Tab indexing and ARIA descriptors are explicitly fixed for assistive technologies.
expectations: Inputs get associated label elements and appropriate types and autocomplete attributes
The removed focus outline is replaced with a visible focus style, and the div button becomes a real button reachable by Tab
Error messaging uses aria-invalid and aria-describedby (and an announced region where appropriate) with sufficient color contrast
The findings are listed, and verification with keyboard-only navigation or an accessibility checker is described
